title: HSBC UK announces new Head of Wealth and Personal Banking - About HSBC | HSBC UK
description: HSBC UK announces Jose Carvalho as new Head of Wealth and Personal Banking

headings.text: HSBC UK announces new Head of Wealth and Personal Banking

body: Share link to this page on X
Share link to this page on Facebook
Share link to this page on LinkedIn
Jose will join the bank early in 2023 from Barclays, where he is currently Head of Consumer Products.
He has over 25-years’ experience in financial services both in the UK and internationally, having held senior positions at Barclays, American Express and Lloyds Banking Group.
Ian Stuart, CEO of HSBC UK, said:

“We are delighted to welcome Jose to HSBC. Jose shares our passion for customer experience, and will be bringing his energy to ensure that we’re opening up opportunities for our customers and allowing them to make the most of their money – now and into the future.”

“I am delighted to be joining HSBC UK at such a key point in the company’s growth. I look forward to working with the team to drive forward products and services that deliver an enhanced service to our customers while also supporting our ambitions to grow the business.”

HSBC UK serves over 14.85 million customers across the UK, supported by 23,500 colleagues. HSBC UK offers a complete range of retail banking and wealth management to personal and private banking customers, as well as commercial banking for small to medium businesses and large corporates. HSBC UK Bank plc is a wholly owned subsidiary of HSBC Holdings plc.

HSBC Holdings plc, the parent company of HSBC, is headquartered in London. HSBC serves customers worldwide from offices in 63 countries and territories in its geographical regions: Europe, Asia, North America, Latin America, and Middle East and North Africa. With assets of US$2,985bn at 30 June 2022, HSBC is one of the world’s largest banking and financial services organisations.
